execution_effect: None. A repository declaration is never deployment, release, ON or Done.
old_contracts_and_history: Keep original backlog bytes/SHA256, all original task contracts and all original/correction capability definitions unchanged.
Keep backlog_ledger and correction_ledger bytes/hash prefixes, old actions, units, proofs, blocked/unknown outcomes and all model/call/action budgets unchanged.
Add development_ledger only if absent; verify any existing ledger against exactly this independently bound registry. Never reset the ledger by changing the registry.
Preserve parent_completion_enabled, independent requirement collectors and final dependency gates. All new units are fixture/development_only/completes_task=false.
reviewed_migration_steps: Authenticate the actual PM account and inspect active jobs, expected installed source/config/policy hashes and original plan digest.
Wait for a safe quiescent PM boundary; acquire the PM loop/journal mutexes. Do not stop or replace another active model call/Worker. Back up exact configuration/state/SQLite and registry bytes.

Validate the unchanged original plan plus this registry; verify original task/owner/requirements, new exact file scopes, validators and source CI. Copy the registry outside all editable checkouts and pin its actual bytes.
Add exactly these 24 capabilities to the current policy and release list. Apply only the explicitly reviewed finite per-task envelope. Validate policy serialized bytes stay below 256 KiB.
Migrate policy digest metadata under both locks with an explicit append-only operator event and old/new source/config/policy/registry hashes. Preserve every original usage/reservation.

Check actual controller owner_paths for every exact product/test path and both job-specific immutable record paths. Never enable forbidden operating paths. Existing packet schema already supports dependency_job_ids.
Build/hash-pin the reviewed fixed runtime outside the checkout. Verify login/isolation/publisher separation/Worker presence and all required readiness receipts; ON alone is not readiness.
Publish actual main/formal snapshot ACK, restart fixed CLI and verify each selected unit was actually queued/claimed/running before reporting startup.
development_dispatch_contract: Only the protected development registry/policy authorizes development_only fixture scope. No model can invent new tasks, paths, commands or expected independent answers.

Accepted implementation prerequisite IDs are verified in the independently bound ledgers and mapped to exactly one reconciled actual queue-accepted job. Those exact job IDs are sent as dependency_job_ids.

These fixture packets use formal_task_dependencies=[] and max_attempts=1. Parent dependency lists are unchanged and still govern original units, live product completion, final evaluation and submission.
Same-tick offers and actual active/review jobs hold owner/file/resource scope. One available owner receives one deterministic offer at a time.
No unexplained blocked/unknown action is retried, refunded or deleted. No paid API fallback or rate-limit bypass is introduced.
